scripts.lb:up: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.redis.yml -f docker-compose.nginx.yml up -d --build --wait nginx
scripts.postlb:up: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.redis.yml -f docker-compose.nginx.yml exec -T nginx nginx -s reload
scripts.lb:stop: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.redis.yml -f docker-compose.nginx.yml stop nginx backend-3000 backend-3001 audio-worker
scripts.lb:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.redis.yml -f docker-compose.nginx.yml logs --tail=100 nginx backend-3000 backend-3001
scripts.lb:logs:3000: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.redis.yml -f docker-compose.nginx.yml logs --follow --tail=100 backend-3000
scripts.lb:logs:3001: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.redis.yml -f docker-compose.nginx.yml logs --follow --tail=100 backend-3001
